name: handoff
description: Handoff cards for work left to a later session, kept as markdown files in the repo's handoff/ folder (the session's directory outside git): serves `card` (create, update, or with status done close a card, which moves it and its doc into handoff/closed/; nothing is deleted) and `list`, shows the cards in a band above the prompt with each card's age and status and an all/open/hold filter (/handoff hides or shows it), and points the model at them on a session's first prompt

hold_on_exit.title: Hold /clear and /exit with uncommitted changes
hold_on_exit.description: When the repo has uncommitted changes and no card was written or closed this session, the first /clear or /exit is held with a reminder; entering it again goes through. Off: /clear and /exit are never held.
